risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Implementation Validation & Interoperability Testing, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to require system developers/integrators consult with security, compliance and/or resilience personnel to: 
(1) Create and implement a Security Testing and Evaluation (ST&E) plan, or similar capability;
(2) Implement a verifiable flaw remediation process to correct weaknesses and deficiencies identified during the control testing and evaluation process; and
(3) Document the results.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development (TDA-17) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of PQC Implementation Validation & Interoperability Testing (QTS-10) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Technical Verification
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to perform Control Validation Testing (CVT) activities to evaluate the design, implementation and effectiveness of technical security, compliance and resilience controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Technical Verification (IAO-11) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of PQC Implementation Validation & Interoperability Testing (QTS-10) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
